status: All 47 frozen findings and rating reservations have explicit responses; the new duration-range correction was implemented and validated after the scored round6 study.

duration_mode_bounds.title: Show and enforce the real duration range for the chosen mode
duration_mode_bounds.response: Shared duration controls and the numeric keypad now derive mode-specific bounds from the current source window, intersected with the remaining timeline. Stretch preserves the existing 25%–400% source-speed constraint; invalid drafts remain editable and cannot be applied.
duration_mode_bounds.acceptance: For an unstretched 4-beat pattern, Stretch exposes its valid 1–16 beat duration range; 56 beats is rejected before Apply and 16 beats succeeds. Mode switches, source-rate changes, valid fractional values, no-op/cancel and Undo retain correct semantics.
duration_mode_bounds.score_policy: This correction follows the frozen round6 reports. Scores are not revised, and no additional fresh participant round is claimed.

findings.observation: Setting a four-beat pattern to 56 beats with Stretch selected left its duration unchanged and showed Stretch must stay between 25% and 400% of source speed. The keypad itself had displayed a much larger general numerical range.
findings.response: The duration keypad and other timing controls now use the chosen mode and current source window to show and enforce valid bounds. For the original unstretched 4-beat pattern, Stretch accepts 1–16 beats; 56 remains an invalid editable draft before Apply. Five running-app cases passed, including exact bounds, shared entry paths, ghosts, timeline limits and no-op inspection. The old frozen build failed the invalid-draft regression as expected.
findings.initial_response: The keypad advertised a general range broader than the active Stretch operation permits. Constrain the field/pad to the actual current mode before accepting an impossible duration.

findings.observation: A 16-beat stretch succeeded. Clicking the visible Duplicate tool and then clips created adjacent copies. Trimming the final audio and MIDI clip edges to bar 15 produced the visible title duration 0:30.000.
findings.response: The participant successfully used a valid 16-beat stretch, duplication and trim. The final validated duration bounds make that valid range explicit without altering the original successful output or weakening source-speed limits.
findings.initial_response: A valid16beatstretch already succeeded, followed by duplication and trimming to30seconds. The correction should expose this valid range immediately, preserving the observed recovery and existing stretch limit.
